shortBulletSummary: Crypto markets rebound, ETF inflows return. Bitcoin hit over $62K, Ethereum over $1.7K, with ETFs seeing inflows.
Weak US jobs data eases Fed rate hike fears. Softer payrolls suggest less aggressive Fed policy, boosting risk assets.

Macro headwinds and AI competition persist. Sticky interest rates, strong USD, and AI asset competition weigh on crypto.
